out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED TOWEL IN THE HANDWASHING SINK ACROSS FROM THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: TOWEL REMOVED/PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND SOAP DISPENSER EMPTY AT THE HANDSINK ACROSS FROM THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: HAND SOAP REFILLED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED BACON IN FOUR-DRAWER STACKED PREP-TOP AT 46-48F. BACON WAS COOKED OVER A DAY PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: COOKED BACON DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED ONE-DOOR UNDER COUNTER COOLER AT 46F AND TWO-DOOR COUNTER-TOP COOLER AT 44F AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE HAVE COOLERS FIXED AT HOLDING FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. COOLERS SHOULD BE SET ~35F TO ENSURE THEY HOLD FOOD AT THE PROPER TEMPERATURE. PLEASE SEND INVOICE/PROOF OF REPAIR BY MAY 17TH.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: melted unsalted butter on the counter under a heat lamp: temperature of 78F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated butter to 165F and reviewed Hot holding parameters with EHS

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine, Thermometers
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device for the (wash/rinse/sanitizing) tank of the warewashing machine is (missing/not operating.) The dish machine plate simulating thermometer is not operating ( battery was changed and still not operating) during time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine shall be equipped with a temperature measuring device that indicates the temperature of the water in each wash and rinse tank and as the water enters the hot water sanitizing final rinse manifold or in the chemical sanitizing solution tank. PIC ordered a new dish plate for heat sanitizing dish machine.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. EHS informed manager of CFM requirement for food establishments. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: EHS observed handwashing sinks by the cookline and the handwashing sinks by the high temperature dish machine did not have paper towels provided.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS informed PIC, PIC replaced paper towels at all handwashing sinks. COURTYARD FAIRFAX FAIR OAKS (Inspection Date: 05/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: EHS observed in a 2x2 door stacked cooler in the KTICHEN area next to the three compartment sink raw shell eggs being stored over Ready to eat salad dressings.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS informed PIC about Raw shell eggs over salad dressings, PIC moved raw shell eggs so they were being stored under the ready to eat salad dressings

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: EHS observed melted unsalted butter being held on the counter at 97F, below minimum required temperature of 135F using a calibrated thermometer
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC disposed of unsalted melted butter, reviewed minimum required temperature with EHS and discussed options of how to hot hold the melted unsalted butter

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: EHS observed a non working thermometer in the 2x2 stacked cooler (1 in report) and 1 door under counter cooler (4 in report)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS informed of the need of ambient air temperature thermometers, PIC agreed to check and replace all air ambient air temperature thermometers.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed in use scissors been stored in such a manner that it was hanging into a trash can between uses
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS informed PIC, PIC removed scissors to a clean dry storage location

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Utility Lines/Pipes, Not Exposed
violations.observation: EHS observed a missing ceiling tile in the kitchen area exposing utility pipes and air ducts to the Kitchen area above a food prep surface.
violations.corrective_action: Utility line and pipes cannot be unnecessarily exposed on a wall or ceiling. PIC agreed to have ceiling closed by next inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK BLOCKED BY POPCORN MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM MOVED POPCORN MACHINE AWAY FROM HAND SINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE SALAD DRESSINGS IN VICTORY 4 DR STACKED REF.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED UNLABELLED SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF VARIOUS LIQUIDS AT COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM TO HAVE EMPLOYEES LABEL BOTTLES WITH FOOD NAME: OIL, SYRUP, ETC.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOT WATER TAP INOPERABLE AT HAND SINK NEAR DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: CFM TO PLACE WORK ORDER FOR HAND SINK TO ENSURE HOT WATER TAP IS OPERABLE.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. CFM TO PURCHASE COVERED TRASH CAN FOR WOMEN’S RESTROOM. COURTYARD FAIRFAX FAIR OAKS (Inspection Date: 12/09/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE’S PERSONAL BELONGINGS STORED UNDER COUNTER OF PREP TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CFM TO ENSURE ALL EMPLOYEES UTILIZE EMPLOYEE LOCKERS FOR STORAGE OF PERSONAL BELONGINGS.
